s.note: Sonny taking Julian to his favourite sports bar
s.how: Bake 1.2kg chicken wings at 220C for 40 minutes until crisp. Toss in 150ml barbecue sauce and bake 5 more minutes until sticky. Serve with ranch and celery sticks.
Split and toast 4 bagels and spread with 200g cream cheese. Cut each in half and stack on a plate. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Sonny letting Julian make all the rules
m.how: Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and grill 4 minutes a side, adding cheese at the end. Set out buns, lettuce, tomato, pickles and sauces and let everyone build their own.

w.note: the most fun dad in New York
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over warm chocolate sauce, scatter with sprinkles and top each with a cherry. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp drinking chocolate into 1L cold milk until dissolved. Pour into tall glasses over ice and add a straw to each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
